label: Touches or is continuous with: Contact or continuity between a mover and what it moves, which…
term: touches or is continuous with (ἅπτεσθαι ἢ συνεχὲς εἶναι)
definition: Contact or continuity between a mover and what it moves, which Physics VII.1, 242b24-26 requires between a primary local mover and what it moves, and which links all members of VII.1's chain into one thing (242b26). Lean: the primitive `Touches y x`, covering both; the typed readings use only that it holds between adjacent members of a chain.
